10 observations kept from 45 archive versions, 2025-01-08T07:06:14Z to 2025-01-16T05:16:43Z (8 inside the replay window). Time = PolygonDateTime, else DateCurrent; 4 versions carried a stale PolygonDateTime (set by an earlier version with a different polygon) and use DateCurrent. Dropped 5 InFORM placeholder versions (single 3-vertex triangles sized to the reported acreage, not mapped perimeters): 381 at 2025-01-08T06:14:32Z, 0.1 ac; 382 at 2025-01-08T06:18:30Z, 399.9 ac; 385 at 2025-01-08T06:36:15Z, 399.9 ac; 388 at 2025-01-08T06:36:15Z, 399.9 ac; 405 at 2025-01-08T13:19:59Z, 2,226.6 ac. First mapped perimeter: 2025-01-08T07:06:14Z (version 389, 1,276 ac, 4.8 h after the reported start 2025-01-08T02:18:00Z). Dropped: 30 re-saves or duplicates (under 1% different), 0 stub(s) under 5 ac. Each feature is the cumulative union of observations so far, clipped to the final extent (version 98888, 14,021 ac). Unclipped, the union ends at 15,227 ac (+8.3% vs official); most of the excess is early mapping outside the final extent: 484 961 ac, 390 218 ac, 628 105 ac. Final cumulative 13,960 ac vs official 14,056 ac (-0.7%). Area check: the CAL FIRE final perimeter measures 14,056.4 ac in this frame vs its GIS_ACRES 14,056.3 (+0.00%). 38 candidate spot components (< 50 ac, > 10 m from the main footprint) in spots.geojson, timed by the observation that first maps them, not by when they ignited.
